requirements: Validate exact particle ordering, graph, parameters, exclusions, declared coordinate changes and box against frozen native sources.
No newly inverted or degenerate native tetrahedral stereocenters; independently inspect repaired loop peptide geometry, Ramachandran/rotamers and introduced clashes.

No unexcluded positive-LJ pair below0.60 times its native LJ minimum after the declared clash relief. Metal coordination must also be evaluated using total Coulomb/LJ/C4 terms, not rejected from LJ repulsion alone.

Report Mg first-shell identities/distances and the ADP/phosphate/ligand coordination geometry before and after every preparation stage. A distance-only shell count is diagnostic, not a chemical approval.
Keep all loop/terminus/microstate choices and C4 alias transfers visible in the report.
All three limits must pass at identical positions, box, constraints, cutoff, PME alpha/grid and parameter bytes; finiteness is required for every value.
Compare each force group and the total original Hamiltonian, including C4, exceptions, reciprocal/direct electrostatics and dispersion correction.
Use native Reference as oracle; endpoint41/44-atom precision passes do not establish periodic full-model correctness.
Repeat comparisons before/after minimization and after a trajectory segment. Record actual CUDA device, precision, driver, runtime, source/input hashes.
Do not change the physical Hamiltonian or relax limits to repair numerical implementation errors. Any physical model change requires a new version.

Retain the original quantum campaign and failed rank/method-sensitivity/runtime checks. Reproduce all27 calculations, including the baseline, in the separately pinned corrected campaign; no suspect original energy is reused as new evidence.

Retain original 4.184kJ/mol profile RMSE, method sensitivity and full-molecule held-out MAE limits;8.368kJ/mol worst/barrier error;15degree minimum-location error; full rank and condition<=1e6 for any independently transferred Fourier coefficients.
A rank-deficient aggregate fit cannot validate or transfer individual torsion coefficients. No automatic endpoint parameter edits are permitted.
Validate cofactor charge/torsion choices and explicit c5->c3, ns->n, nv->n C4 polarizability transfers against compatible references or separately declared QM/coordination benchmarks.
A GPU QM runtime pass establishes numerical agreement only; it does not clear any force-field quality gate.

Freeze an exact common-core atom map and lambda-dependent Hamiltonian for both solvated legs, including softcore functional form/parameters, electrostatics, exceptions, torsions, C4 terms and dummy restraints.
Prove lambda0 and lambda1 physical energies/forces match their corresponding nativeA/B endpoints under G2 limits after explicitly accounting for dummy terms.
Derive and test any dummy restraint/partition-function corrections and demonstrate cancellation between the matched-box legs; equal box dimensions alone are insufficient proof.
Check identical total charge throughout the transformation, mass and constraint rules, periodic treatment and compatible endpoint microstates.
Test intermediate lambdas for finite energies/forces and analytic-versus-finite-difference derivatives; store cross-evaluated reduced potentials for the estimator.

project_specific_validation_criteria_dec.NVE_note: Both step sizes must pass; report all per-component and total drift. These are declared project diagnostics, not a universal accuracy standard. Constraint projection and removal of center-of-mass momentum must be recorded.
project_specific_validation_criteria_dec.temperature_interval: Last100ps of each200ps equilibration, after accounting for actual constrained degrees of freedom

requirements: Evaluate constrained NVE on all four nativeA/B complex/solvent endpoints before stochastic sampling. The existing ten steps at0.1fs are only a smoke test.
Record constraint residuals, energy drift and physical stability across loop, ligand and cofactor coordinates, not just global finiteness.

Check NVT temperature distribution against the actual constrained degrees of freedom and expected fluctuations. Fixed volume does not establish a correct solution density; report virial pressure/density and investigate sustained pathological pressure before sampling.
Any need to change box/density requires rebuilding both matched legs and revalidating dummy corrections under a versioned amendment.

initial_schedule.total_cost_scope: Always quote both legs, all16windows and all3repeatpairs, plus preparation/pilots, reporting transactions and infrastructure when applicable. Missing priced terms are unknown, never zero.

bounded_extensions.stop_rule: Stop this version when limits pass or the cap is reached. Retain unconverged output; do not publish it as accepted. New windows or altered physical settings require a versioned amendment.

stages.estimator: MBAR from cross-evaluated reduced potentials, independently cross-checked with adjacent-window BAR; retain all repeated simulations and discarded-equilibration decisions

project_specific_acceptance.note: Report time-correlation/overlap and repeat heterogeneity with uncertainty; error bars alone are not evidence of convergence. Thresholds are declared project decisions rather than guarantees of chemical truth.

structural_controls: Track ligand pose, protein loop stability, Mg coordination and cofactor geometry by repeat and lambda.
A stable but unintended pose/coordination state is not automatically accepted. Inspect alternate-state and microstate sensitivity before interpreting affinity.
Parameter/model uncertainty remains separate from finite-sampling statistical error.
